title: Signed finite Tate sheaves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative ring and $m\in\mathbb N$ with $mA=0$. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], use the module-valued encoding [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Extend the nonnegative twists $A_T(n)$ of [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist] to integers by keeping $A_T(n)$ for $n\geq0$ and defining $A_T(-n-1)=\mathcal Hom_A(A_T(n+1),A_T(0))$, using the sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The local pure-tensor generator in $A_T(1)$ attached to $a\in A$ and $z\in\mu_{m,T}(U)$ is the image of $a\otimes z$ under the sheafification unit of the scalar-extension construction.

source.place: Tag 03PK, section-kummer; arbitrary coefficient extension and finite signed tensor powers on the small etale site
